exposure: travel time more than 1 hour to hospital
cohort: The cohort consists of 353 laboring mothers who were referred to and gave birth at public hospitals in Bahir Dar City, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: The level of poor maternal referral practice was 52.7%, and it was significantly associated with illiteracy, low monthly income, being referred from other referral hospitals, mode of birth (cesarean section or assisted delivery), and longer travel time to the hospital.
mod_finding: Giving birth via cesarean section or assisted delivery were significantly associated with poor maternal referral practice.
